title: Transition Supply Benefit Schedule, Northbridge Formularies
content:
For each formulary of the Formulary Benefit, this schedule sets the terms on which a member may receive a temporary transition supply of a non-formulary drug: the length of the transition window, the most that one transition fill may supply, the number of fills allowed per drug, the tier charged, and the deadline for the transition notice.

| Term | Exclusive | Value | Standard | Preferred Drug List | Broad | Open |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Transition fills allowed | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Transition window, calendar days (start date as day 1) | 60 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 120 |
| Maximum days supply for one transition fill | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Transition fills of the same drug per window | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Members moved here by a sponsor formulary change also get a window | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Cost-share tier charged on a transition fill of a non-formulary drug | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Transition notice sent within (business days of the fill) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |

The columns are the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List, Northbridge Broad Formulary and Northbridge Open Formulary.

## Reading the schedule

- The window is counted in calendar days from the transition start date, which is day 1. For a window of 90 days, day 90 is the start date plus 89 days.
- The fill count is per drug and per window. On the Northbridge Preferred Drug List, Broad and Open formularies a member may receive two transition fills of the same drug in one window. On the other three formularies the limit is one.

*Hypothetical.* On the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, with a transition start date of 1 January, day 60 is 1 March in a common year. A transition fill dated 1 March is inside the window and one dated 2 March is outside it.
